data.description:
This VR simulation teaches the essential skill of cleaning upper or lower dentures, focusing on hygiene and patient comfort. The tutorial includes preparation, communication, denture removal, cleaning, and reinsertion.

With multi-language support (English, Spanish, French, and Arabic), this simulator ensures inclusivity and accessibility for a global audience.  

The experience is enhanced by an AI companion, acting as a virtual mentor, to answer questions to reinforce learning.
 
# Key Features: 
- Multi-Language Support: Tailored instructions and narrations in four major languages to cater to diverse learners. 
- AI Companion: An interactive assistant that responds to user queries, and provides clarifications to meet learning needs.(NOTE: Generative AI is still experimental)

 By the end of this tutorial, participants will be able to: 
- Remember the steps and safety protocols for cleaning dentures. 
- Understand the importance of maintaining proper oral hygiene for patients with dentures. 
- Apply the correct techniques for removing, cleaning, and reinserting dentures. 
- Analyze the condition of the dentures and the oral cavity to provide appropriate care. 
- Evaluate their technique to ensure it adheres to best practices and safety standards. 
- Create a hygienic and comfortable experience for patients during denture cleaning. 

This comprehensive approach ensures CNAs are well-prepared to assist patients with proper care efficiently and compassionately in real-world clinical settings.
